diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~85% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.22), which favours a robust combination.
